title: Lab Arrangement Request
content:
This is to inform all the students who have not yet purchased their laptops that they are required to write a formal request email to Rabia Ma’am.
Students are advised to send the email at the earliest to avoid any academic inconvenience.

title: Contest 2 – Preparation Guidelines
content:
This is to inform all students that Contest 2 scheduled for this week will include questions based on basic loops and conditional statements.

The contest will be conducted after the teaching session on loops. Students are advised to prepare loop concepts in advance in order to perform well in the contest.

Timely preparation will help you gain better understanding and achieve good results.

Best wishes for your preparation.
